Interview Experience  
Oracle 2024 
  
Nikhil Soni 
02.08.2024  
Final Year IT (2021-25)  
INTRODUCTION  
Role - Associate Application Developer

1  
  
Organization - Oracle Financial Software Services Ltd.  
Eligibility: Circuit Branches(CS, IT, EXTC, Electronics, Electrical)  
CGPA - 7+ | No Active Backlogs | 12th - 70% | 10th - 70%  
Location - Mumbai / Pune / Bangalore / Chennai  
Salary - 19.1 CTC ( Base-14.5 + 20K USD Stocks(25% redemption every year) + PF )  
HIRING WORKFLOW  
1. Online Test  
2. PPT ( TPO Seminar Hall )  
3. Technical Round  
4. Managerial Interview with VP 
5. Technical Round 
6. Technical Round 
7. HR Interview  
ONLINE TEST  
Hackerrank Platform (Online)| 5:00 PM 2/8/24 | 120 mins | 36 Questions  
1. Coding (1):  
I don’t remember the exact question ,but it was a variation of the Same tree question. We had to 
implement the tree from scratch. 
 
2. Aptitude   
3. Grammar   
4. Core Subject question.  
Tip: "Remember to avoid errors in Aptitude and Grammar, as they affect your overall score. I solved the 
coding question successfully (all test cases passed), but the Aptitude and Grammar sections are also 
important."  
50 students were shortlisted. They divided the students into two groups for two roles, and based on 
that, the interviews were scheduled.

2  
  
TECHNICAL INTERVIEW  
TPO (Offline)| ~ 50 Mins  
1. The interviewer told me to introduce myself.  
2. Then She asked some basic OOPS and core Java questions. 
3. I was asked to write the complete syntax to implement maps in Java on paper. The interviewer 
looked satisfied with my work. 
4. Then she gave me 2 tables and told to write an sql join query for a given output. I made a 
mistake at start, but with the hints I was able to write the correct query. 
5. In my resume, all the projects were built using Flutter, and the interviewer did not have any 
experience with it, so I explained why I had used Flutter. 
6. Then she asked some HTML and CSS questions. 
      Prepare these for the Interview:  
Introduction | DSA(striver 180) | SQL | HR Ques |DBMS | OS |  Oops  
At any point, the interviewer can ask you to write the code for anything. So don’t mention things that 
you are not confident about.  
 
MANAGERIAL INTERVIEW WITH VP 
TPO (Offline) | ~ 50 Mins  
1. Firstly, the VP went through my resume and asked how was my internship experience.    
2. Then he asked about my family background. He asked why am I not joining my family business , I 
told him the reason and he seemed pretty impressed by it.  
3. I had mentioned that I am also a trek leader. He asked how it started and why do I like it. He also 
asked which places I have visited. 
4. Then he asked how do you manage people during trips , I shared with him 2 different scenarios 
during treks and explained how did I managed them. 
5. Then he gave a me 2-3 scenarios and asked how would I react to them.

3  
TECHNICAL ROUND 
TPO (Offline) | ~ 25 Mins  
1. There were 2 interviewers , they went through my resume and asked some basic questions 
about the projects like why this techstack, features, etc. 
 
2. One of them asked me to explain my internship project, I explained and he seemed impressed. 
3. Then they asked me to choose between 2 questions, they told me 1 would be hard and the 
other would easy, but also, I had to write the code of easy question without any help and the 
syntax should be correct, while in hard, they would give hints and there can be some syntax 
errors in the code. 
 
4. I had chosen the hard one. There was a long story related to 2 villages, but it was a simple, 
minimal platform required question. 
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/problems/minimum-platforms-1587115620/1 
 
5. But the twist was, arrival and departure were not given, I had to assume this as an input, the 
interviewer told me you can take any data from the station master. 
 
6. I tried different things, but couldn’t think of taking the arrival and departure times of the trains. 
 
7. Then asked some basic Java questions related to OOPS. 
 
 
TECHNICAL ROUND 
TPO (Offline) | ~ 40 Mins  
1. The interviewer went through my resume and also the rough sheets of my previous rounds; he 
told me it's great that I know Java. 
 
2. Then he asked some questions on OOPS, like inheritance and polymorphism. he told me to write 
an example of polymorphism in Java. 
 
3. Then he asked some questions related to firebase , he gave an set collections in firebase and 
told me to write the flutter code to get this data on frontend. 
 
4. He asked a question related to coin and probability. I don’t remember the exact question. 
 
5. He told me to write a code that included a hashset.

4  
HR ROUND 
TPO (Offline) | ~ 10 Mins  
1. The HR called all 5 students selected for the OFSAA team. 
 
2. She asked our preferred location : Mumbai or Bangalore. 
 
3. Then she asked how the entire interview process was. 
 
4. At the end, she asked whether we had any questions or not. 
 
 
Final results were out at 5 pm, 10 students were selected, and I was one of them. Two days after,  2 
more students were selected, so the total was 12. 
Tips: 
1. Always use pen and paper (or a whiteboard) to explain concepts. This allows the interviewer to 
easily refer back to any point during the discussion. 
2. All of my interview rounds were conducted in Hindi. It's perfectly fine if you're more comfortable 
in Hindi, but let the interviewer initiate the language switch — don't change the language 
yourself. 
3. Use the STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) method to explain your projects. This helps in 
presenting your experience in a structured and impactful way.
